description: AI assistant panel with Generate, Improve, Summarize, and Ask tabs. Runs the AI provider, streaming output into a live region, and offers run, accept (as HTML), retry, cancel, and discard.

parameters.name: Visible
parameters.description: Controls whether the AI menu is rendered.

parameters.name: ContextHtml
parameters.description: Selected or page HTML context passed to the provider.

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: Initial mode selected when the menu opens.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: Fixed left coordinate for inline menu placement.

parameters.name: OnAccepted
parameters.description: Raised when generated output is accepted. The argument is sanitized HTML.

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Raised when the user closes or discards the menu.

parameters.name: PageId
parameters.description: Optional page identifier used for summary and page-scoped questions.

parameters.name: Panel
parameters.description: Renders the component as a wider page-level panel.

parameters.name: Provider
parameters.description: Explicit provider used by tests or advanced integrations. Defaults to the editor context provider.

parameters.name: SourceText
parameters.description: Selected plain text used by the improve mode.

parameters.name: TargetCulture
parameters.description: Optional target culture for translation requests.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: Fixed top coordinate for inline menu placement.
